ctx.x: Oh. Got a little worried there.

Yeah. So he stayed down there. But this is what I was told. I never saw this. I still would believe it. But nevertheless Procope was in Fletcher's band, and he, along with Hilton Victor Jefferson -- I think Hawk was in the band then, and Buster Bailey was playing clarinet, and doubling on tenor for parts. And Procope could play, always was fast, and he stayed with Fletcher's band quite a long time. And he toured and everything, and he's another one of those -- he was always a jolly little guy, you know? Did you…
I've never talked to him. Of course, I've seen him -- with Ellington. Billie.
